en.tool.forecast.description: Execute time series forecasting. Use this when asked about future predictions, trend analysis, sales forecasts, or any numerical forecasting task.
en.param.data.description: CSV file path or DataFrame JSON string with columns/rows structure
en.param.model.description: Forecast model. auto = automatic selection from available models
en.param.frequency.description: Frequency: D=daily, H=hourly, M=monthly, W=weekly, auto=infer
en.param.plot.description: Generate and save forecast plot image
en.error.data_too_small: Insufficient data: need at least %(min_rows)d rows, got %(actual)d
en.error.csv_read_failed: CSV read failed after trying utf-8-sig, cp932, latin-1
en.param.output_dir.description: Directory to save plot image. Defaults to ~/.uag/outputs/forecast_plots

ja.tool.forecast.description: 時系列予測を実行します。将来の予測、傾向分析、売上予測、または数値予測のタスクについて質問された場合にこれを使用します。
ja.param.data.description: CSV ファイルのパスまたは列/行構造を含む DataFrame JSON 文字列
ja.param.model.description: 予測モデル。 auto = 利用可能なモデルから自動選択
ja.param.frequency.description: 頻度: D=毎日、H=毎時、M=毎月、W=毎週、自動=推測
ja.param.plot.description: 予測プロット画像の生成と保存
ja.param.outlier.description: 異常値の処理: なし/iqr/zscore
ja.error.data_too_small: データが不十分です: 少なくとも %(min_rows)d 行が必要ですが、%(actual)d 行を取得しました
ja.error.missing_rate_high: 欠落率 %.1f%%: 予測できません
ja.error.csv_read_failed: utf-8-sig、cp932、latin-1 を試行した後、CSV の読み取りに失敗しました
ja.error.all_models_failed: すべてのモデルに障害が発生したか、使用できなくなりました
ja.error.timeout: 予測がタイムアウトしました (%(seconds)d 秒)
ja.info.plot_saved: プロットは %(path)s に保存されました
ja.param.horizon.minimum_error: 水平線は少なくとも 1 でなければなりません
ja.param.output_dir.description: プロットイメージを保存するディレクトリ。デフォルトは ~/.uag/outputs/forecast_plots

fil.tool.forecast.description: Isagawa ang pagtataya ng serye ng oras. Gamitin ito kapag tinanong tungkol sa mga hula sa hinaharap, pagsusuri sa trend, mga pagtataya sa benta, o anumang gawain sa pagtataya ng numero.
fil.param.data.description: CSV file path o DataFrame JSON string na may mga column/rows structure
fil.param.value_column.description: Pangalan ng target na column para sa pagtataya
fil.param.horizon.description: Bilang ng mga panahon ng pagtataya
fil.param.model.description: Modelo ng pagtataya. auto = awtomatikong pagpili mula sa mga available na modelo
fil.param.frequency.description: Dalas: D=araw-araw, H=hourly, M=monthly, W=weekly, auto=infer
fil.param.plot.description: Bumuo at i-save ang forecast plot image
fil.error.data_too_small: Hindi sapat na data: kailangan ng hindi bababa sa %(min_rows)d row, nakakuha ng %(actual)d
fil.error.csv_read_failed: Nabigo ang pagbabasa ng CSV pagkatapos subukan ang utf-8-sig, cp932, latin-1
fil.error.all_models_failed: Nabigo o hindi available ang lahat ng modelo
fil.param.horizon.minimum_error: ang horizon ay dapat na hindi bababa sa 1
fil.param.output_dir.description: Direktoryo upang i-save ang larawan ng plot. Default sa ~/.uag/outputs/forecast_plots

ms.tool.forecast.description: Laksanakan ramalan siri masa. Gunakan ini apabila ditanya tentang ramalan masa depan, analisis aliran, ramalan jualan atau sebarang tugas ramalan berangka.
ms.param.data.description: Laluan fail CSV atau rentetan DataFrame JSON dengan struktur lajur/baris
ms.param.model.description: Model ramalan. auto = pemilihan automatik daripada model yang tersedia
ms.param.frequency.description: Kekerapan: D=harian, H=sejam, M=bulanan, W=mingguan, auto=infer
ms.param.plot.description: Hasilkan dan simpan imej plot ramalan
ms.error.data_too_small: Data tidak mencukupi: memerlukan sekurang-kurangnya %(min_rows)d baris, mendapat %(actual)d
ms.error.csv_read_failed: Bacaan CSV gagal selepas mencuba utf-8-sig, cp932, latin-1
ms.error.all_models_failed: Semua model gagal atau tidak tersedia
ms.param.output_dir.description: Direktori untuk menyimpan imej plot. Lalai kepada ~/.uag/outputs/forecast_plots

da.tool.forecast.description: Udfør tidsserieprognoser. Brug dette, når du bliver spurgt om fremtidige forudsigelser, trendanalyse, salgsprognoser eller enhver numerisk prognoseopgave.
da.param.data.description: CSV-filsti eller DataFrame JSON-streng med kolonne-/rækkestruktur
da.param.model.description: Forecast model. auto = automatisk valg fra tilgængelige modeller
da.param.frequency.description: Hyppighed: D=dagligt, H=time, M=månedligt, W=ugentlig, auto=infer
da.error.data_too_small: Utilstrækkelige data: brug for mindst %(min_rows)d rækker, fik %(actual)d
da.error.csv_read_failed: CSV-læsning mislykkedes efter at have prøvet utf-8-sig, cp932, latin-1
da.error.all_models_failed: Alle modeller fejlede eller er ikke tilgængelige
da.param.output_dir.description: Directory for at gemme plotbilledet. Som standard er ~/.uag/outputs/forecast_plots

nn.tool.forecast.description: Utfør tidsserieprognoser. Bruk dette når du blir spurt om fremtidige spådommer, trendanalyse, salgsprognoser eller en kva som helst numerisk prognoseoppgave.
nn.param.data.description: CSV-filbane eller DataFrame JSON-streng med kolonner/rader-struktur
nn.param.model.description: Prognosemodell. auto = automatisk valg frå tilgjengelege modeller
nn.param.frequency.description: Frekvens: D=daglig, H=time, M=månedlig, W=ukentlig, auto=infer
nn.error.data_too_small: Utilstrekkelig data: trenger minst %(min_rows)d rader, fikk %(actual)d
nn.error.csv_read_failed: CSV-lesing mislukkast etter å ha prøvd utf-8-sig, cp932, latin-1
nn.error.all_models_failed: Alle modellene mislukkast eller er utilgjengelige
nn.param.output_dir.description: Katalog for å lagre plottbilde. Standardinnstillingen er ~/.uag/outputs/forecast_plots
